card.p: Deploy vLLM with PagedAttention and continuous batching to maximize token throughput per GPU, targeting peak utilization for production LLM workloads.
Configure tensor parallelism and pipeline parallelism across multiple GPUs or nodes to serve large models (e.g., 70B+ parameters) with minimal latency overhead.
Containerize and deploy vLLM on Kubernetes with auto-scaling, health checks, and GPU resource management for elastic, self-hosted LLM serving.
Analyze serving cost per token and GPU memory usage, then tune vLLM parameters (batch size, scheduler policy, quantization) to reduce expense without sacrificing throughput.
Evaluate existing LLM serving infrastructure for bottlenecks in latency or cost, and migrate from other frameworks (e.g., TGI, Ray Serve) to vLLM for better performance.
